note: First batch of Paytime help articles (2026-11-10), written from the current screens. Loaded as DRAFT by backend/scripts/seed-sevco-help.js; a super user approves each one in SEVCO → Paytime Help before the assistant uses it.

af.title: Oortyd op 'n payslip invoer
af.body:
1. Gaan na Employees en maak die werknemer oop.
2. Kies bo-aan die maand by Period.
3. Onder Pay for Additional Hours, klik + Add langs ⏰ Overtime.
4. Vul die Date en Hours in en kies die Rate Multiplier: 1.5x (gewone oortyd), 2.0x (dubbel, bv. Sondae of openbare vakansiedae), 2.5x of 3.0x.
5. Klik Save. Die payslip word herbereken.
Let wel: oortyd word teen die werknemer se uurtarief op sy volle salaris bereken. 'n Maand wat reeds gefinaliseer is, kan nie meer verander word nie.

en.title: Add overtime to a payslip
en.body:
1. Go to Employees and open the employee.
2. Choose the month at the top under Period.
3. Under Pay for Additional Hours, click + Add next to ⏰ Overtime.
4. Fill in the Date and Hours and choose the Rate Multiplier: 1.5x (normal overtime), 2.0x (double, e.g. Sundays or public holidays), 2.5x or 3.0x.
5. Click Save. The payslip is recalculated.
Note: overtime uses the employee's hourly rate on the full salary. A month that is already finalized cannot be changed.

af.title: Korttyd (ure gemis) invoer
af.body:
1. Gaan na Employees en maak die werknemer oop.
2. Kies die maand by Period.
3. Onder Pay for Additional Hours, klik + Add langs ⏱️ Short Time.
4. Vul die Date, Hours Missed en 'n Reason in.
5. Klik Save. Die salaris word verminder met die ure gemis teen die werknemer se uurtarief.
Let wel: bywoning (Attendance) kan korttyd ook voorstel; dié inskrywings wys "from attendance".

en.title: Enter short time (hours missed)
en.body:
1. Go to Employees and open the employee.
2. Choose the month under Period.
3. Under Pay for Additional Hours, click + Add next to ⏱️ Short Time.
4. Fill in the Date, Hours Missed and a Reason.
5. Click Save. The salary is reduced by the hours missed at the employee's hourly rate.
Note: Attendance can also propose short time; those entries show "from attendance".

af.title: 'n Item elke maand op 'n payslip sit (bv. toelae of aftrekking)
af.body:
1. Gaan na Employees en maak die werknemer oop.
2. In die blok Regular Inputs (Monthly), klik + Add.
3. Kies die soort (Allowance, Income, Benefit, Deduction of Other) en die item, en tik die bedrag.
4. Klik ✓ Add to Monthly Payslip.
Die item kom nou elke maand op die payslip totdat jy dit verwyder.
Let wel: die items en hul belastinginstellings (belasbaar, UIF, IRP5-kode) word op die Payroll Items-skerm opgestel.

en.title: Put an item on the payslip every month (e.g. an allowance or deduction)
en.body:
1. Go to Employees and open the employee.
2. In the Regular Inputs (Monthly) block, click + Add.
3. Choose the type (Allowance, Income, Benefit, Deduction or Other) and the item, and type the amount.
4. Click ✓ Add to Monthly Payslip.
The item now appears on the payslip every month until you remove it.
Note: items and their tax settings (taxable, UIF, IRP5 code) are set up on the Payroll Items screen.

af.title: Iets net vir hierdie maand byvoeg (bv. bonus of kommissie)
af.body:
1. Gaan na Employees en maak die werknemer oop.
2. Kies die maand by Period.
3. In die blok Current Inputs (This Month), klik + Add.
4. Kies die soort (bv. Bonus, Commission, Allowance of Deduction), gee 'n beskrywing en die bedrag.
5. Klik ✓ Add to This Month's Payslip.
Dit geld net vir daardie maand. 'n Eenmalige bedrag word in die maand van betaling ten volle belas.

en.title: Add something for this month only (e.g. a bonus or commission)
en.body:
1. Go to Employees and open the employee.
2. Choose the month under Period.
3. In the Current Inputs (This Month) block, click + Add.
4. Choose the type (e.g. Bonus, Commission, Allowance or Deduction), give a description and the amount.
5. Click ✓ Add to This Month's Payslip.
It only applies to that month. A once-off amount is taxed in full in the month it is paid.

af.title: Ure teen 'n ander uurtarief betaal
af.body:
Gebruik dit as 'n werknemer ure teen 'n ander tarief werk, bv. hy doen iemand anders se werk teen R20,50 per uur.
1. Maak die werknemer se payslip oop en kies die maand.
2. Onder Pay for Additional Hours, klik + Add langs 💵 Paid at Different Rate.
3. Vul die Description, Hourly Rate (R) en Hours in.
4. Klik Save. Die bedrag (ure × tarief) word by die bruto loon getel en belas.

en.title: Pay hours at a different hourly rate
en.body:
Use this when an employee works hours at another rate, e.g. doing someone else's job at R20.50 per hour.
1. Open the employee's payslip and choose the month.
2. Under Pay for Additional Hours, click + Add next to 💵 Paid at Different Rate.
3. Fill in the Description, Hourly Rate (R) and Hours.
4. Click Save. The amount (hours × rate) is added to gross pay and taxed.

af.title: 'n Nuwe werknemer byvoeg
af.body:
1. Gaan na Employees en klik + Add Employee.
2. Vul die werknemer se besonderhede in: First Name, Last Name, ID Number, SARS Tax Number (10 syfers), Date Appointed, Payment Method en bankbesonderhede.
3. As die werknemer nog nie by SARS geregistreer is nie, merk Not yet registered with SARS in plaas daarvan om die belastingnommer leeg te los (die IRP5 word dan geblokkeer totdat die nommer ingevul is).
4. Klik Save Employee.
5. Maak die werknemer oop om die basiese salaris en gereelde items in te sit.
Let wel: die ID- en belastingnommer word nagegaan; 'n verkeerde nommer word nie aanvaar nie.

en.title: Add a new employee
en.body:
1. Go to Employees and click + Add Employee.
2. Fill in the employee's details: First Name, Last Name, ID Number, SARS Tax Number (10 digits), Date Appointed, Payment Method and bank details.
3. If the employee is not yet registered with SARS, tick Not yet registered with SARS instead of leaving the tax number empty (the IRP5 is then blocked until the number is filled in).
4. Click Save Employee.
5. Open the employee to enter the basic salary and regular items.
Note: ID and tax numbers are checked; an invalid number is not accepted.

af.title: 'n Werknemer se diens beëindig
af.body:
1. Gaan na Employees en soek die werknemer.
2. Klik End Service.
3. Kies die Service End Date (die laaste werksdag) en gee 'n rede indien nodig.
4. Klik Confirm End of Service.
In die laaste maand word die salaris pro-rata bereken tot by die einddatum. Ná daardie maand word die werknemer nie meer in die payroll ingesluit nie. Gebruik Show Inactive om oud-werknemers weer te sien.

en.title: End an employee's service
en.body:
1. Go to Employees and find the employee.
2. Click End Service.
3. Choose the Service End Date (the last working day) and give a reason if needed.
4. Click Confirm End of Service.
In the last month the salary is pro-rated up to the end date. After that month the employee is no longer included in payroll. Use Show Inactive to see former employees again.

af.title: 'n Werknemer se salaris verander of verhoog
af.body:
1. Maak die werknemer se payslip-blad oop.
2. Klik op Basic Salary om dit te wysig.
3. Tik die nuwe bedrag, kies Effective from (die maand vanaf wanneer dit geld) en gee 'n Reason.
4. Klik Save.
- Is die maand in die toekoms, word die verhoging geskeduleer en geld dit vanself vanaf daardie maand.
- Is die maand reeds gefinaliseer, wys Paytime eers die agterstallige betaling (back pay). As jy bevestig, word dit as eenmalige "Back pay" by die eerste oop maand gevoeg. Gefinaliseerde payslips verander nie.
Die geskiedenis van salarisveranderings wys onderaan die venster.

en.title: Change or increase an employee's salary
en.body:
1. Open the employee's payslip page.
2. Click Basic Salary to edit it.
3. Type the new amount, choose Effective from (the month it applies from) and give a Reason.
4. Click Save.
- If the month is in the future, the increase is scheduled and applies automatically from that month.
- If the month is already finalized, Paytime first shows the back pay. If you confirm, it is added as a once-off "Back pay" to the first open month. Finalized payslips do not change.
The salary history shows at the bottom of the window.

af.title: Die maand se payroll uitvoer en finaliseer
af.body:
1. Gaan na Execute Payroll.
2. Kies die maand by Select Period (en die skedule by Select Schedule indien julle meer as een het).
3. Kies die werknemers (Select All vir almal) en klik ▶ Run Payroll.
4. Gaan die resultate en payslips na. Maak enige foute op die werknemers se payslip-blaaie reg en run weer.
5. Klik Finalize Payroll. Lees die nagaan-verslag (groot veranderinge, ontbrekende belastingnommers, negatiewe netto) en klik dan ✓ Yes, Finalize.
Na finalisering is die payslips gesluit. Daarna kan jy die Bank File aflaai en Bulk Print Payslips gebruik.

en.title: Run and finalize the month's payroll
en.body:
1. Go to Execute Payroll.
2. Choose the month under Select Period (and the schedule under Select Schedule if you have more than one).
3. Choose the employees (Select All for everyone) and click ▶ Run Payroll.
4. Check the results and payslips. Fix any mistakes on the employees' payslip pages and run again.
5. Click Finalize Payroll. Read the review (large changes, missing tax numbers, negative net pay) and then click ✓ Yes, Finalize.
After finalizing, the payslips are locked. You can then download the Bank File and use Bulk Print Payslips.

af.title: 'n Gefinaliseerde maand omkeer om 'n fout reg te maak
af.body:
1. Gaan na Execute Payroll en maak die maand oop (of soek dit onder 📋 History).
2. Klik 🔄 Reverse Pay Run.
3. Gee 'n rede (verpligtend) en bevestig.
Die payslips word ontsluit sodat jy dit kan regmaak en weer kan run en finaliseer. Die ou payslips bly as "reversed" in die geskiedenis.
As latere maande reeds gefinaliseer is, waarsku Paytime jou vooraf en bied aan om dié maande ook om te keer, want hul PAYE is op die ou syfers gebaseer.

en.title: Reverse a finalized month to fix a mistake
en.body:
1. Go to Execute Payroll and open the month (or find it under 📋 History).
2. Click 🔄 Reverse Pay Run.
3. Give a reason (required) and confirm.
The payslips are unlocked so you can fix them, run and finalize again. The old payslips stay in the history as "reversed".
If later months are already finalized, Paytime warns you first and offers to reverse those months too, because their PAYE is based on the old figures.

af.title: 'n Nuwe payroll-item opstel (bv. 'n toelae of aftrekking)
af.body:
1. Gaan na Payroll Items.
2. Kies die blok: Income, Allowances, Deductions of Employer Contributions, en klik die + Add-knoppie daarvan.
3. Vul in: Item Code, Item Name, Category en die IRP5 Code.
4. Stel die belasting: Taxable? en Taxable % (bv. 80% vir 'n reistoelae), Affects UIF?, en vir aftrekkings die Tax Treatment (Pre-Tax vir pensioen/voorsorg, anders Normal Deduction).
5. Kies by Show this item in of dit Regular, Once-Off of albei is, en die Monthly Behaviour.
6. Klik Save.
Let wel: 'n item sonder IRP5-kode gee 'n waarskuwing by elke payroll en blokkeer die werknemer se IRP5 by jaareinde.

en.title: Set up a new payroll item (e.g. an allowance or deduction)
en.body:
1. Go to Payroll Items.
2. Choose the block: Income, Allowances, Deductions or Employer Contributions, and click its + Add button.
3. Fill in: Item Code, Item Name, Category and the IRP5 Code.
4. Set the tax: Taxable? and Taxable % (e.g. 80% for a travel allowance), Affects UIF?, and for deductions the Tax Treatment (Pre-Tax for pension/provident, otherwise Normal Deduction).
5. Under Show this item in, choose Regular, Once-Off or both, and the Monthly Behaviour.
6. Click Save.
Note: an item without an IRP5 code gives a warning on every payroll run and blocks the employee's IRP5 at year end.

af.title: 'n Maatskappymotor (belasbare byvoordeel) byvoeg
af.body:
1. Maak die werknemer se payslip-blad oop.
2. Onder Company car (taxable benefit), klik + Add.
3. Tik die determined value (koopprys ingesluit BTW, sonder rente), merk of 'n onderhoudsplan ingesluit is, en of besigheidsgebruik minstens 80% is.
4. Kies From month en klik Save.
Paytime bereken elke maand 3,5% van die waarde (2,5% met 'n onderhoudsplan) en belas 80% daarvan (20% by 80%+ besigheidsgebruik). Dit word nie in kontant betaal nie. Wanneer die werknemer nie meer die motor het nie, klik End en kies die laaste maand.

en.title: Add a company car (taxable benefit)
en.body:
1. Open the employee's payslip page.
2. Under Company car (taxable benefit), click + Add.
3. Type the determined value (purchase price incl. VAT, excl. finance charges), tick whether a maintenance plan is included and whether business use is at least 80%.
4. Choose From month and click Save.
Each month Paytime calculates 3.5% of the value (2.5% with a maintenance plan) and taxes 80% of it (20% at 80%+ business use). It is not paid in cash. When the employee no longer has the car, click End and choose the last month.

af.title: 'n Payslip sien, aflaai of druk
af.body:
Een werknemer:
1. Maak die werknemer se payslip-blad oop en kies die maand by Period.
2. Klik Calculate Payslip (vir 'n oop maand) of Preview Payslip.
3. Klik Download PDF of Print.
Almal saam (ná finalisering):
1. Gaan na Execute Payroll en maak die gefinaliseerde maand oop.
2. Klik Bulk Print Payslips.
Die payslip wys ook die jaar-tot-datum-totale (YTD).

en.title: View, download or print a payslip
en.body:
One employee:
1. Open the employee's payslip page and choose the month under Period.
2. Click Calculate Payslip (for an open month) or Preview Payslip.
3. Click Download PDF or Print.
Everyone at once (after finalizing):
1. Go to Execute Payroll and open the finalized month.
2. Click Bulk Print Payslips.
The payslip also shows the year-to-date (YTD) totals.
